tag: 海港貿易展攤位人員配置與徵才博覽會應對備忘錄

level.why: 句子多為含 which、provided that、since 的複合句與被動結構，並需整合班次、服裝、應徵者應對與去年成果等多項資訊；干擾項取自文中同時出現的概念（job fair、reference letter、loyalty app）。

passage:
To: Marketing and Sales Team
Subject: Staffing Plan for the Harbor Trade Expo

Our booth at the Harbor Trade Expo, which opens on November 18, has been enlarged to nine meters in width, allowing us to demonstrate the new loyalty app while reserving a small corner for recruitment. Because the organizers are running a job fair alongside the exhibition, Human Resources has asked us to promote our trainee program, provided that doing so does not distract from the product demonstrations.

Each shift will be led by one sales executive, supported by two associates, and all staff are expected to wear business attire in the company's navy colors. Anyone who wishes to change shifts must contact Ms. Alvarez by Friday, since the available slots are already almost full. Please steer applicants who approach the booth toward the HR desk instead of discussing salary yourselves, and remind them that candidates are being evaluated against published criteria, including relevant experience and a reference letter from a previous employer.

Last year's expo generated tremendous interest, with more than 1,200 leads collected over three days. To maintain that momentum, we will review the first day's results at a short briefing, after which the demonstration schedule may be adjusted accordingly.
zh:
收件人：行銷與業務團隊
主旨：港灣貿易展人員配置計畫

我們在 11 月 18 日開幕的港灣貿易展攤位已擴大為寬九公尺，讓我們既能展示新的會員忠誠度應用程式，也能保留一小塊角落做招募。由於主辦單位在展覽期間同步舉辦徵才博覽會，人力資源部已要求我們宣傳公司的儲備受訓計畫，但前提是這麼做不能妨礙產品展示。

每個班次將由一位業務主管帶領，並由兩位助理協助，所有人員都應穿著公司海軍藍色系的商務服裝。任何想換班的人，請在週五前聯絡艾瓦雷茲女士，因為可選的時段幾乎都已排滿。請把前來攤位詢問的應徵者引導到人資櫃檯，而不要自己討論薪資，並提醒他們，應徵者將依公布的標準接受評估，包括相關經驗以及前雇主所寫的推薦信。

去年的展覽引起極大的關注，三天內共蒐集到超過 1,200 筆潛在客戶資料。為了維持這股氣勢，我們將在簡短的簡報會上檢視第一天的成果，之後可能會據此調整展示時程。

vocab.col: steer customers toward / steer a conversation

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To announce the launch date of a loyalty app
To explain staffing arrangements and expectations for the company's expo booth
To invite job seekers to a recruitment event
To report the results of last year's expo
why: 文中提到 loyalty app，但只是展示項目，非信件主旨。
正解：信件說明攤位的人員配置、服裝、換班與應對應徵者的要求。
job fair 由主辦單位舉辦，信件並非對求職者的邀請，而是給內部團隊。
去年成果只在最後一段簡短帶過，不是主要目的。

questions.q: What are booth staff asked to do when applicants approach?
opts: Collect reference letters on the spot
Direct them to the HR desk
why: 文中明言不要自己討論薪資（instead of discussing salary）。
推薦信是評估標準之一，但並未要求現場收取。
正解：steer applicants toward the HR desk，即引導至人資櫃檯。
主辦單位舉辦 job fair，但並未要求轉介給主辦單位。

questions.q: What is mentioned about last year's expo?
opts: It featured a demonstration of a loyalty app
It lasted for a full week
It resulted in more than 1,200 leads
why: 忠誠度應用程式是今年要展示的，並非去年。
文中說去年是三天，不是一週。
job fair 是今年主辦單位的安排，文中未說去年也有。
正解：三天內蒐集到超過 1,200 筆 leads。

questions.q: Candidates for the position will be assessed against clearly defined ______.
why: 正解：criteria 為 criterion 的複數，前面無冠詞，作 against 的受詞。
criterion 為單數，前面需有冠詞 a／each。
critic 指評論家，語意不符。
critically 為副詞，不能作介系詞受詞。

questions.q: The demonstration schedule will be revised ______ the feedback gathered from visitors on the first day.
why: basing on 不是慣用搭配，且不符合此句結構。
based 單獨使用後須接 on 才能表示根據。
正解：on the basis of + 名詞，表示「根據…」。
base for 語意與結構皆不通。

questions.q: Customers who are dissatisfied with a purchase may request a refund ______ they present the original receipt.
why: in spite of 是介系詞片語，後不能接子句。
as to 後接名詞，不能引導條件子句。
正解：provided that 引導條件子句，意為「只要…」。
rather than 表示「而不是」，語意不符。
